# How to farm for Raider and Settler Reputation in Fallout 76

In collaboration with __Fargassier__

__Used for__

Reputation levels are used to unlock plans that are sold by:

**Mortimer at Crater**

**Samuel at Foundation**

You do not need to have any reputation to purchase plans from __Minerva__, however, there are some plans that Minerva does not sell, which only Samuel and Mortimer sell.

__Regs__ sells plans that are not Reputation locked, but he can only be accessed once you have completed the Wastelanders quest line.

__Reputation Ranks__

__Quests__

Completing the Wastelanders questline will reward you with Reputation, depending on your playstyle and what faction you side with.

It is recommended that you complete the quests for both the Raiders and the Settlers until you reach the quest "Siding with", to maximise your rewards and the amount of reputation that you gain.

You can lose reputation with each faction if you make inappropriate comments or SPECIAL checks. This can range from -10 to -70 reputation.

**Raiders quests**

| **Quest Name** | **Reputation Earnt** |
| Overseer, Overseen | 75 |
| Strange Bedfellows | 250 |
| Cheating Death | 500 |
| Fun and Games | 500 |
| The Ol' Weston Shuffle | 500 |
| From Russia with Lev | 500 |
| Buried Treasure | 750 |
| **Siding with Crater - Split with Raiders** | **1000** |
| **Siding with Crater - Keep the Gold** | **-500** |
| **Siding with Crater - Split with both factions** | **300** |

**Settlers quests**

| **Quest Name** | **Reputation Earnt** |
| Overseer, Overseen | 75 |
| Here to Stay | 250 |
| Trade Secrets | 500 |
| Invisible Ties | 500 |
| Duty Calls | 500 |
| Division of Wealth | 500 |
| All That Glitters | 750 |
| **Siding with Foundation - Split with Settlers** | 1000 |
| **Siding with Foundation - Keep the Gold** | -500 |
| **Siding with Foundation - Split with both factions** | 300 |

At the end of the Wastelanders questline, If you really mess up and end up with a faction that is still hostile toward you, then fast-travel to the Wayward and speak to Cherise.

For a price, they can remove the faction's hostility.

If you are at -2000 or less Reputation, pay 250 caps

If you are between -2000 to -3000 Reputation, pay 500 caps

If you are between -3000 to -4000 Reputation, pay 750 caps

If you are between -5000 or more Reputation, pay 1000 caps

__Events__

**Public Event: Moonshine Jamboree**

Rewards 250 Raider Reputation

**Public Event: Eviction Notice**

Rewards 250 Settler Reputation

__Pip-Boy Dailys__

When you fast-travel to each location, you will get a pop-up or notification in the right-hand top corner of your screen or in your pip-boy.

If you do not get a pop-up, then it's possible that the quest is already active in your pip-boy and you haven't completed it. Go to the data tab and then daily. Scroll down the list and look for the below quest names.

Note: Although they are called Pip-Boy Dailys, these quests will not pop up every day. They work on a rotation with one new Daily being available every 24 hours. This means it can take 3 to 5 days before the daily that you want will be available again.

__Daily: The Importance of Communication__

**Faction:** Raiders

**To Start:** Speak to Wren in Crater

**Task:** Wren needs parts to maintain Crater's communications.

**Notes:**

- Select the dialogue "On the House" when turning the quest in and you will receive an additional 25 Raider Reputation.

**Base Reward:** 200 Raider Reputation.

__Daily: Retirement Plan__

**Faction:** Raiders

**To Start:** Speak to Rocksy in Crater

**Task:** Deal with former Crater gang members.

**Notes:**

- If you let the former Raider live, pass the Charisma +8 SPECIAL check, and send them to Foundation, you will receive 25 Settler Reputation.
- Lie to Rocksy and tell her that you killed the former Raider to receive an additional 25 Raider Reputation.
- Kill the former Raider and tell Rocksy "Appalachia has a new corpse" to receive an additional 25 Raider Reputation.
- Convince the Raider to return back to Crater and receive an additional 10 Raider Reputation.

**Base Reward:** 200 Raider Reputation.

__Daily: Vital Equipment__

**Faction:** Settlers

**To Start:** Speak to Ward at Foundation.

**Task:** Recover Foundation's stolen equipment.

**Notes:**

- If you let the Raider keep the item, you will lose 10 Settler Reputation and gain 10 Raider Reputation. You will not receive the base reward of 200 Settler Reputation.
- If a Blood Eagle has the item, there will be no option for them to keep the item.
- If you donate the reward back to Foundation, you will receive an additional 50 Settler Reputation.

**Base Reward:** 200 Settler Reputation.

__Daily: Photo Opportunity__

**Faction:** Neutral

**To Start:** Speak to Davenport at the Overseer's New Home in Sutton

**Task:** Take surveillance photos for Davenport.

**Notes:**

- If you choose to take photos of the Raiders, sell them to Ward and donate the reward back to Foundation for 75 Settler Reputation.
- If you choose to take photos of the Settlers, sell them to Kiyomi and donate the reward back to Crater for 75 Raider Reputation.
- You will not receive a reward if you do not return the photos to Davenport.

**Base Reward:** Refer to the Notes section.

__Refuge Daily: Recipe for Success__

**Faction:** Neutral

**To Start:** Speak to Esme in the Whitesprings Refuge.

**Task:** Join Esme Rousseau in whipping up a delicious stew.

**Notes:**

- Give the Good Stew to the Raider Rep for 250 Raider Reputation
- Give the Burnt Stew to the Raider Rep for 100 Raider Reputation
- Give the Good Stew to the Settler Rep for 250 Settler Reputation
- Give the Burnt Stew to the Settler Rep for 100 Settler Reputation

**Base Reward:** Refer to the Notes section.

__Unmarked Dailys__

Note: These NPCs will be hostile toward you until you have reached neutral or higher Raider Reputation.

__Raider Fish Camp Defend__

**Faction:** Raiders

**To Start:** Speak to Fishbones at Ohio River Adventures

**Task:** Defend the purifiers from the Mirelurk attack.

**Notes:** This daily can be hard to start. You need to talk to Fishbones multiple times before he will give you the daily quest.

**Rewards:** +10 Raider Reputation

__Raider Fish Camp Quest__

**Faction:** Raiders

**To Start:** Speak to Blackeye at Ohio River Adventures

**Task:** Turn in different types of Mirelurk Meat and Eggs.

**Notes:** This can only be completed once a day.

**Rewards:**

Donate 5x Mirelurk Softshell Meat +10 Raider Reputation

or

10x Mirelurk Meat +10 Raider Reputation

or

1x Mirelurk Queen Meat +25 Raider Reputation

or

15x Mirelurk Eggs +10 Raider Reputation

__Random Encounters__

Rewards +10 Reputation per successful Encounter.

If you don't want to wait for your dailys to refresh or want to get the reputation grind over and done with, then you can farm Random Encounters for Settler and Raider reputation.

A successful encounter is killing whatever is attacking the Settlers or Raiders. At least one Settler or Raider needs to be alive at the end and you need to interact and speak with the surviving NPC for the reputation to be applied.
